text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
“—A crushing defeat. ...I was at my 
absolute worst today.”

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
She let me enter because she believed I 
could do it. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I couldn't... live up to your trust...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Just how... how can I ever apologize for 
this...?
choice_data_list:
Let's chalk that up as valuable 
experience!
You should reflect deeply on this

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. My grandfather used to 
say it, too. The only way to make up for a 
mistake at work is through work.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I will make sure this defeat— serves as a 
stepping stone to the next step, without 
fail.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(They're not usually a scary person... Yet 
for my sake, they're deliberately being 
strict...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I will take that to heart. I won't let 
you suffer like that ever again."
